qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Unassailable global leader in molecular sample preparation and QuantiFERON latent-TB diagnostics, generating >85% recurring consumable revenues. Tangible ROIC >34% and multi-year FCF conversion >100%. COVID windfall normalized with core non-COVID business compounding peak-to-peak. Modest leverage (net debt <2x earnings) and >15x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: sample-prep/QuantiFERON volume 4.5% + price 1.5% + portfolio mix 0.5% + net share buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: QIAGEN holds a ~60-70% global market share in biological sample preparation (DNA/RNA extraction) and gold-standard status with QuantiFERON-TB. Tangible ROIC has consistently exceeded 30% (median 34.2%), and FCF conversion averaged 128% over the last four years. Post-pandemic normalization of COVID testing windfalls is complete, with 2025 sales ($2.09B) and net income ($425M) well above pre-COVID 2019 levels ($1.53B and $338M). Balance sheet is sound with $815M net debt repayable in <2 years and interest coverage of 15.7x.
